title: Where did all the public bathrooms go?
summary: A Hacker News discussion referencing a JSTOR Daily article exploring the historical decline of public bathroom availability in urban spaces, examining social, economic, and policy factors that led to their disappearance from cities and public venues.
problem_solved: Raises awareness about the lack of public restroom infrastructure in modern cities and its impact on public life.
why_valuable: Highlights an often-overlooked urban infrastructure issue that affects public health, accessibility, and quality of life for all citizens.
